ai_summary: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited has secured a substantial domestic Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) contract valued at INR 10.6 billion (approximately $127 million USD) for a 47.8 MW solar power project, significantly boosting its order book and renewable energy footprint. While this is a material positive impact on future revenues, the contract is a related-party transaction with a step-down subsidiary of the company. A potential red flag is the project's execution timeline being contingent on land acquisition, introducing a risk of delays.
